Ground chili pepper falls under HTSUS heading 0904: "Pepper of the genus Piper; fruits of the genus Capsicum or of the genus Pimenta, dried or crushed or ground." Within 0904.22 ("Crushed or ground"), the 10-digit subheading is 0904.22.4000 for Capsicum, other than "Neither crushed nor ground." I need to check the 0904.22 breakdown.

0904.21 covers dried, neither crushed nor ground, and 0904.22 covers crushed or ground. Under 0904.22, the subheadings are:
- 0904.22.05 – Pepper of the genus Piper
- 0904.22.20 – Capsicum, other: Paprika (?)
- 0904.22.40 – Capsicum
- 0904.22.60 – Pimenta

I recall 0904.22.2000 as "Pepper of the genus Piper: Black / White", and 0904.22.4000 as "Capsicum: Chili pepper, ground"? I'm not sure. The CBP rulings for ground red chili pepper powder from Korea cite 0904.22.4000, which I think reads "Fruits of the genus Capsicum... Crushed or ground: Other: Capsicum, ground" — I believe the ruling classification is 0904.22.4000. I'll go with it.

{"hts_code": "0904.22.4000", "reason": "Dried, heat-treated and ground 100% Capsicum red chili pepper powder is classified in heading 0904 as crushed or ground fruits of the genus Capsicum (subheading 0904.22)."}
